gaps.sentence: ___ Galapagos Islands are famous for unique wildlife.
gaps.explanation: Groups of islands take 'the': the Galapagos Islands, the Canary Islands.

gaps.sentence: He's always been fascinated by ___ universe.
His wife goes to ___ prison every Sunday to visit him.
gaps.explanation: Here 'the prison' is the building she visits, not the institution of imprisonment.

gaps.sentence: He was sent to ___ prison for armed robbery.
gaps.explanation: 'Be sent to prison' (as a prisoner) takes no article; visiting the building is 'go to the prison'.

gaps.sentence: It was ___ best meal I've ever had.
He was ___ last person to leave the building.
gaps.explanation: Ordinals take 'the': the last person, the first time.

gaps.sentence: She earns her living as ___ journalist.
gaps.explanation: Jobs after 'as' take a/an: as a journalist.

gaps.sentence: Mount Everest is ___ highest mountain in the world.
